effectEntries.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Drains half the damage inflicted to heal the user.
effectEntries.shortEffect: Drains half the damage inflicted to heal the user.

effectEntries.effect: Inflige des dégats réguliers. Draine la moitié des dégâts infligés pour soigner le lanceur.
effectEntries.shortEffect: Draine la moitié des dégâts infligés pour soigner le lanceur.

descriptions.text: The user drains the target’s blood. The user’s HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.

Steals 1/2 of the damage inflicted.
A blood-draining attack. The user’s HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.
An attack that steals half the damage inflicted.
An attack that absorbs half the damage it inflicted to restore HP.

The user attacks by draining the target's blood. Some of the damage dealt to the target is absorbed by the user to restore their own HP.
